decisions.reason: The abstract states 'All patients had a genetic diagnosis of CLN7 with homozygous or compound heterozygous mutations in the MFSD8 gene.' In the context of a study about CLN7 disease where patients with MFSD8 mutations are diagnosed with CLN7, this clearly establishes that MFSD8 mutations cause CLN7 disease. The causal relationship is supported by the background stating the study evaluates CLN7 disease spectrum and all patients with CLN7 genetic diagnosis had MFSD8 mutations.

The quoted sentence 'Language problems were noted prior to or at the onset of seizures in all cases.' directly states that language problems are a clinical finding in the CLN7 disease cohort. The subject of the statement is CLN7 patients and the phenotype is language problems. This is a direct observation of CLN7 disease phenotype.

The quoted sentence 'Gait problems were noted prior to seizure onset in 3 of 8 patients, and at or within 6 months after the onset of seizures in 5 of 8 patients.' directly describes gait problems as a clinical finding in CLN7 disease patients. This is a direct observation of CLN7 disease phenotype.

While the quoted sentence lists seizures as part of information collected ('neurological events including seizures'), the surrounding abstract clearly establishes that seizures are a clinical manifestation of CLN7 disease in this cohort (mentioned multiple times as a key clinical event in patients' disease progression). The relationship is supported by the results section which discusses 'onset of seizures' as a clinical milestone in CLN7 patients.

While the quoted sentence lists neurodevelopmental regression as part of information collected, the surrounding results section establishes that neurodevelopmental regression is indeed a clinical manifestation of CLN7 disease ('All patients followed a progressive course of language, motor, and neurocognitive deterioration'). The abstract clearly establishes this as part of the disease phenotype.

The quoted sentence 'All patients followed a progressive course of language, motor, and neurocognitive deterioration.' directly states that motor deterioration is a clinical phenotype of CLN7 disease. Motor deterioration is explicitly listed as part of the progressive course observed in all CLN7 patients studied.

The quoted sentence 'All patients followed a progressive course of language, motor, and neurocognitive deterioration.' directly states that neurocognitive deterioration is a clinical phenotype of CLN7 disease. Neurocognitive deterioration is explicitly listed as part of the progressive course observed in all CLN7 patients studied.
